opinionEv.quote: In our opinion and to the best of our information and according to the explanations given to us, the aforesaid standalone financial statements give the information required by the Companies Act, 2013 ('the Act') in the manner so required and give a true and fair view in conformity with the accounting principles generally accepted in India, of the standalone state of affairs of the Company as at 31 March 2026, and standalone total comprehensive income (comprising of profit and other comprehensive income), standalone changes in equity and its standalone cash flows for the year then ended.
